themeDescription: Where AI helps, where humans shine, collaboration

days.title: What is Creativity? - Making Something New and Valuable
days.learning_objective: Define creativity as the combination of novelty and value, understanding its essential role in human flourishing.

days.title: Where Ideas Come From - Connecting Existing Concepts
days.learning_objective: Understand that creativity often involves novel combinations of existing ideas rather than creation from nothing.

days.title: Can AI Be Creative? - Pattern Recombination vs True Novelty
days.learning_objective: Explore the debate about AI creativity, distinguishing between statistical pattern recombination and genuine creative insight.

days.title: Human Creativity - Imagination, Intuition, Intention
days.learning_objective: Appreciate the uniquely human elements of creativity: intentionality, emotional depth, and meaning-making.

days.title: Creative Collaboration - Humans and AI Together
days.learning_objective: Explore how humans and AI can collaborate creatively, each contributing unique strengths.

days.title: AI as Creative Tool - Augmenting Human Creativity
days.learning_objective: Learn to use AI as a tool that extends and amplifies human creative capabilities.

days.title: AI as Creative Spark - Prompts and Starting Points
days.learning_objective: Use AI to generate prompts, ideas, and starting points that spark human creative development.

days.title: AI as Creative Critic - Getting Feedback from AI
days.learning_objective: Learn to use AI for constructive feedback on creative work while maintaining your own creative vision.

days.title: When to Use AI - The Right Tool for the Right Task
days.learning_objective: Develop judgment about when AI enhances the creative process versus when it hinders it.

days.title: When to Go Alone - Pure Human Creativity
days.learning_objective: Recognize when purely human creativity is more valuable or appropriate than AI-assisted work.

days.title: Brainstorming - Generating Many Ideas
days.learning_objective: Master brainstorming techniques that generate quantity of ideas as the path to finding quality.

days.title: Filtering - Choosing the Best Ideas
days.learning_objective: Develop criteria and processes for evaluating and selecting the best ideas from many options.

days.title: Combining - Mixing Ideas Together
days.learning_objective: Practice the creative skill of combining disparate ideas into novel and valuable syntheses.

days.title: Iterating - Making Ideas Better
days.learning_objective: Embrace iteration as essential to creativity—first ideas are starting points, not endings.

days.title: Creative Process - Stages from Inspiration to Completion
days.learning_objective: Understand the typical stages of creative work: preparation, incubation, illumination, verification.

days.title: Creative Block - When Ideas Don't Come
days.learning_objective: Develop strategies for overcoming creative block and maintaining creative momentum.

days.title: Creative Courage - Taking Risks with Ideas
days.learning_objective: Build the courage to share creative work and take risks that genuine creativity requires.

days.title: Creative Community - Sharing and Feedback
days.learning_objective: Engage with creative communities for inspiration, feedback, and collaborative growth.

days.title: Creative Expression - Art, Writing, Music, Design
days.learning_objective: Explore diverse forms of creative expression and find modes that resonate with you.

days.title: Creative Problem-Solving - Innovation in Any Field
days.learning_objective: Apply creative thinking to practical problems, recognizing that creativity isn't just for 'the arts.'

days.title: Design Thinking - A Framework for Creativity
days.learning_objective: Learn the design thinking process: empathize, define, ideate, prototype, test.

days.title: Constraints and Creativity - Limits That Inspire
days.learning_objective: Discover how constraints and limitations often enhance rather than diminish creative output.

days.title: Play and Creativity - The Power of Experimentation
days.learning_objective: Embrace playful experimentation as a path to creative discovery and joy.

days.title: Failure and Creativity - Learning from What Doesn't Work
days.learning_objective: Reframe creative failure as essential feedback that guides toward better ideas.

days.title: Originality - What Does It Mean to Be Original?
days.learning_objective: Explore what originality means when all creativity builds on what came before.

days.title: Attribution - Giving Credit for Ideas
days.learning_objective: Learn the ethics and practices of attribution—giving credit where creativity is influenced or inspired.

days.title: Remix Culture - Building on Others' Work
days.learning_objective: Understand remix culture and the creative tradition of building on and transforming existing work.

days.title: AI Art - Understanding AI-Generated Images
days.learning_objective: Understand how AI generates images, and the creative and ethical questions this raises.

days.title: AI Writing - Understanding AI-Generated Text
days.learning_objective: Understand how AI generates text, and develop critical awareness of AI-written content.

days.title: Your Creative Voice - What Only You Can Create
days.learning_objective: Identify and develop your unique creative voice—the perspective that only you can bring.

days.title: Month in Review - Creativity in the AI Age
days.learning_objective: Synthesize insights about creativity and AI into a personal creative philosophy.
